name: cbio-normal-skin-keratinocytes-2024
description: Whole exome and targeted sequencing data of 137 normal keratinocytes samples from human skin. The study is part of a broader analysis involving three distinct cell types, with findings stratified accordingly (see related melanocytes and fibroblasts studies).

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
